mission.title: woodpecker-ci: Ability to limit concurrent pipelines
mission.description: Ability to limit concurrent pipelines. Requested by 18+ users.

steps.title: Check current woodpecker-ci deployment
steps.description:
Verify your woodpecker-ci version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
helm list -n woodpecker-ci 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working woodpecker-ci installation.

steps.title: Review woodpecker-ci configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant woodpecker-ci configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
kubectl get configmap -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=woodpecker-ci
```
### Clear and concise description of the problem

I remember that original CI had a feature called concurrency https://discourse.drone.io/t/how-to-limit-build-concurrency-per-project/3500
This helped a lot to prevent build run when other build

steps.title: Apply the fix for Ability to limit concurrent pipelines
steps.description:
## What

Adds an optional `concurrency` setting to the workflow YAML that limits how many instances of a workflow (or group) run at the same time, without cancelling running pipelines.

Supports both shorthand and full form:
```yaml

# or
concurrency:
  limit: 1
  group:
```yaml

# or
concurrency:
  limit: 1
  group: deploy
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n woodpecker-ci -l app.kubernetes.io/name=woodpecker-ci
kubectl get events -n woodpecker-ci --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Ability to limit concurrent pipelines" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
## What

Adds an optional `concurrency` setting to the workflow YAML that limits how many instances of a workflow (or group) run at the same time, without cancelling running pipelines.

Supports both shorthand and full form:
```yaml
concurrency: 1
# or
concurrency:
  limit: 1
  group: deploy
```

## Why

"Cancel previous pipeline" isn't safe for deployments: it can abort an in-flight deploy.
